title:
In the sensor association workflow, when attempting to click the save and continue button, it first checks if there are validation errors
in the current step's form. If there are, it will show an error banner immediately.
If not, it will perform the default form validation (checking for null required fields) and show an error if there are validation errors
after default validation. If no errors are present, it will call the {@link BulkSensorAssociationApplicationState#changeStepAction} action.
name: SensorAssociationProceedIfFormIsValidEpic
